inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 JSON page after a sequence cursor, including provisional diagnostics and explicit observation gaps.
limitations: Default shared registry limits are 32768 UTF-8 JSON bytes per event, 1048576 retained event bytes per job, 256 retained events, 65536 bytes per complete event page and 24576 bytes per compact job view.
The 65536-byte page limit applies to the complete jobEvents JSON value, not the MCP JSON-RPC response: text and structured representations duplicate it, and HTTP transport adds its own wrapper.
A page may contain fewer than limit events because of its byte budget. Continue with nextSequence while hasMore; eventPageBytes describes the complete serialized page.
Cursor must not exceed the current sequence. truncated reports older events lost by count or byte eviction; firstAvailableSequence identifies the retained start.

Unsafe or oversized observations become stage observation-event-gap at the same authoritative sequence/type with provisional true, payloadOmitted true and gap.reason; optional gap.originalStage identifies the omitted observation.
eventRetention reports limits and retained event counts/bytes. Oversized job result summaries may omit fields and report summaryOmissions; complete final output remains a separate artifact/export.

An omitted observation or summary field does not change job state and is not evidence of convergence, solver failure or physical accuracy. Pending field queues, retained artifacts and event JSON have separate budgets; these are not worker transport or peak-heap guarantees.
